claims.value: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head for speculative decoding with NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super. It is not a standalone language model and does not contain the target model's backbone weights.
claims.evidence: **NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-BF16-MTPv2** is an updated, separately distributed Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head for speculative decoding with NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super. It is not a standalone language model and does not contain the target model's backbone weights.
**Other Properties Related to Input:** Maximum context length up to 262144 tokens.
